faq_heading: Mountain View Homes for Sale on Burke Mountain: your questions answered

faq.q: What do houses in Burke Mountain sell for?
faq.a: 58 houses sold in Burke Mountain from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, at a median $1,954,000 after 25 days and 96.3% of the last list price. That covers every house in the area, not only those with a view.

faq.q: Is Burke Mountain still being built?
faq.a: Yes. The City of Coquitlam is planning and approving development in stages, so parcels near a home may be vacant or under construction. Ask the City what is planned beside any home you like.

faq.q: Do all Burke Mountain homes have mountain views?
faq.a: No. A view depends on the lot's elevation and what stands in front of it, and the MLS® view field is the listing agent's description.

blocks.text: This search shows Burke Mountain homes whose MLS® view field says Mountain View, live from the MLS®, with land and income properties left out. Burke Mountain is a growing hillside neighbourhood in northeast Coquitlam, so the checks on this page are as much about what is still being built as about what you can see.
Burke Mountain and the mountain behind it

Mount Burke itself is in northeast Coquitlam, and most of it lies inside Pinecone Burke Provincial Park, created in 1995 (Wikipedia, Mount Burke). The neighbourhood called Burke Mountain is the developed land on the lower southern slopes, and the City of Coquitlam has been planning it in stages.
That means a mountain view here is usually a view up to the park forest or across to other ridges, and it is tied to how much of the surrounding slope has been built.

items.t: The City of Coquitlam's Northwest Burke Vision page sets out the planning for the northwest part of Burke Mountain.
Pinecone Burke Provincial Park protects most of the mountain itself, so the forest above the neighbourhood is mostly inside a protected park.
Burke Mountain is still building out, so parcels beside or below a home may be vacant, under construction or approved for development.

blocks.text: On SnapStats' October 2026 count, Burke Mountain had 56 detached homes for sale and 8 sold, a sales ratio of 14%, which reads as a balanced market.

These figures include townhomes and houses of every outlook. The closed-sales export has no view field, so compare a listing with sales on the same street and at the same elevation rather than only with the area median.
What to check on a Burke Mountain view home
The view is only as permanent as the land in front of it, so the first questions are about the neighbouring parcels.

items.t: Ask the City of Coquitlam what is approved or planned for the parcels in front of and below the home.
On a sloped lot, check the retaining walls, drainage and who owns them, and read the strata minutes if the home is a townhome.
Visit on a clear day and again when the cloud is low. Hillside views are often partly in cloud.
Ask whether the view looks at the park forest, other homes or the valley, since that decides how stable it is.
